title: Schindler's List
synopsis: Kraków, 1939. You're a German businessman with a gift for getting on the right side of every officer at every party. The Jews of this city are about to need a list with your name on it.

nodes.text: Officers, cognac, jazz. You buy every round.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Make a connection.” The story records the instinct as “Strategy” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Patient—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: An enamelware factory, abandoned. A man named Stern keeps the books.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Trust.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Safe—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Cheap labor, the regime says. People, you see, when you look at them.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Hire many.” The story records the instinct as “Right” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Cover.

nodes.text: Camp commandant. Cruel. Charming when useful.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategy.
“Avoid him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Goeth's maid. He beats her. You bring her medicine quietly.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Care.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Foolish.

nodes.text: Liquidation day. The streets fill with bodies and shoes. A girl in a red coat.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Watch from the hill.” The story records the instinct as “Witness” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Look away” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Stern brings names. Each name is a person. Each person is a deduction from your factory's price.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Right.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Practical.

nodes.text: You buy people one bribe at a time. The price changes weekly.

choices.consequence: “Pay it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Vow.
“Negotiate” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: You convince Goeth to grant pardons for sport. He likes the idea of being god.

choices.consequence: “Encourage it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Cynical use.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Foolish.

nodes.text: A Jewish wedding in the camp. You attend secretly.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
“Stand far back” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: A train of your women workers is misrouted to Auschwitz.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Now.
There is no taking “Send a telegram first” back. Cautious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You enter the office with a diamond brooch and a smile.

choices.consequence: “Smile larger” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Strategy.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Direct.

nodes.text: The women come back. The relief is private.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Discipline.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Stern, at the typewriter. Names. More names. Eleven hundred names.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Right—follows you into whatever comes next.

choices.text: Add a few you've thought of
choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Memory—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Your fortune is, by now, mostly gone. Each name has cost a price.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Spend the rest” back. Vow shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Survive.

nodes.text: The eleven hundred arrive at Brünnlitz. They are, for now, alive.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Stay in the office.” The story records the instinct as “Discipline” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You make worthless ammunition on purpose. The war ends in slow degrees.

choices.consequence: “Keep faking” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Sabotage.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Safe.

nodes.text: A Russian officer rides in. The workers are no longer prisoners.

choices.consequence: “Speak to them” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
“Stand to the side” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Quiet.

nodes.text: The workers melt down their gold to make you a ring. He who saves one life.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Take the ring.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Refuse” back. Pride shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You break, in front of Stern, over the car you could have sold, the pin you could have sold.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Let it out” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Bury it.” The story records the instinct as “Survival” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You die a poor man, honored. The workers and their children visit your grave for decades.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Be remembered” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Be forgotten quietly.” The story records the instinct as “Modest” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: The ring is, in the end, the only inheritance you wanted to leave. The descendants of the eleven hundred number, by the time you are remembered, more than the population of Kraków.
Stern survives you. He writes the list down again, properly, with photographs. The list, in libraries, becomes a kind of scripture.
Helen survives. She emigrates. Years later she sits at a kitchen table with your widow, drinking coffee, talking about a man neither of them could have predicted.
